we propose a distributed SLAM scheme for resource-limited operation that combines an SEIF method and a measurement selection tool, and that we evaluate it in 3D RO-SLAM experiments with an octorotor UAS.

the proposed scheme: (i) is capable of exploiting the sensing, computational, and communication capabilities of sensor nodes to enhance the accuracy and robustness of RO-SLAM while meeting a resource consumption bound expressed in the number of measurements that can be integrated per SLAM iteration; (ii) achieves significant estimation accuracies and robustness; (iii) has been integrated in a UAS and evaluated in real outdoor experiments, which show its performance and scalability.
